Job Description

About Auric AI
 Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones.
Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error-prone.
Our mission is to use AI-powered vision systems to detect and classify high-value military objects — such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers — so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.  We’re a fast-moving defense technology startup, combining world-class AI research with real-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most. 

The Role
 We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform. This is not a traditional PM role.
You will: Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission-critical contexts. Translate AI research into usable, analyst-facing products. Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions. Be AI-native — using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed. You will own the end-to-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust — all within minutes of image arrival. What You’ll Do 

Vision & Roadmap
 Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near-term MVP delivery with long-term platform growth. 

Workflow & UX Design
 Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst-ready screens. Use AI-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly. 

Feature Prioritization
 Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must-haves from nice-to-haves. Make trade-offs between speed-to-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust. 

Execution & Delivery
 Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases. 

User & Stakeholder Engagement
 Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction. 

Metrics & Success
 Define and track success metrics: time-to-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly. What We’re Looking For AI-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows. First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows. Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily. User empathy: can design for non-technical users working under pressure. Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery. Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users. Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus. 

Why Join Us
 Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI. Collaborate with a small, world-class team of researchers and engineers. High ownership from day one shape the platform, not just maintain it. Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively. Be part of a mission-driven company where AI meets national security. Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence.
If you’re an AI-native product builder who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment — we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to help own Creative AI — a product that takes a brand and turns out finished ad creative (images, resizes, videos, reels, UGC) that actually looks on-brand rather than generic AI output. A lot of it is already live and producing real client work, but it is a deep, fiddly product with many models working behind the scenes, and today most of it runs through a small number of people. We need someone to get into the weeds: write the specs, review the real output with a critical eye, catch what is broken, and help push the roadmap from "powerful but hand-held" toward something a marketer or our creative team can run smoothly every day.This is a genuine hands-on, learn-by-doing role. You will not be handed a finished playbook — you will help write one. It is ideal for someone early in their product career with strong taste, attention to detail, clear writing, and real curiosity about where AI creative is heading.

Key ResponsibilitiesWrite clear specs, user stories, and tickets that turn fuzzy ideas into work an engineer can build without a dozen follow-up questionsReview creative output with a critical eye — running new features and fixes through their paces, catching garbled text, off-brand colours, and broken layouts, and writing up exactly what is wrong with examplesObserve the creative team and clients using the tool to find where it slows them down, and turn those frictions into prioritised fixesSupport the product roadmap by keeping the backlog groomed and honest, tracking what is shipping against the plan, and flagging slips and mismatches with real customer needsDrive recurring customer asks (PSD and open-file support, push-to-platform, better voiceovers, quick-commerce formats) from a vague wishlist into scoped, prioritised workCoordinate across engineering, the creative team, and the senior PM — keeping everyone pointed at the same thing and unblocking small issues before they growDocument how the model-heavy pipeline and features work, so product knowledge stops living only in a couple of engineers' heads
Required Prerequisites2-4 years of experience — a strong recent graduate, someone moving into product from design, marketing, or a creative or analyst background, or an early-career PM looking to go deep on an AI productA demonstrable eye for visual and creative quality — you notice when something looks off (kerning, a slightly wrong logo, a layout that does not breathe)Strong written communication, with the ability to make fuzzy things concrete in specs, bug reports, and summariesGenuine curiosity about AI products and how generation pipelines and models work, even without a coding backgroundStrong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of turning chaos into a tidy list and closing things outComfort with ambiguity and speed in an early, fast-changing product
Core Competencies & SkillsStrong attention to detail and quality judgment, which matters more than almost anything on a creative productPractical familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, v0, or similar for research, documentation, and prototypingClear written communication for specs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and bug reportsAbility to simplify complex AI outputs and multi-step pipelines into clear, understandable user experiencesCustomer-first working style with comfort joining demos, onboarding calls, and feedback sessionsBasic technical fluency — enough to understand why a pipeline has multiple steps and what each model is doingPractical judgment around AI products, including reliability, quality checks, approval flows, and usage costComfort working in a fast-moving startup with changing priorities and early-stage product assumptionsNice to have: a background or strong interest in design, advertising, or marketing; hands-on experience with creative tools (Figma, Canva, Photoshop, or AI tools like Midjourney, Runway, or Kling); and a side project, design, or campaign that shows you can take an idea to done

About SamaaroSamaaro is an AI-powered event marketing platform that helps marketing teams turn events into a measurable growth channel. We cover the full lifecycle — audience targeting, campaign-led promotion, registration, on-site execution, lead capture, CRM sync, and ROI reporting — for in-person, virtual, and hybrid events. Our customers include enterprise teams at PepsiCo, ICICI Lombard, Property Finder, Dr. Reddy's, Sodexo, and many others across India, the Middle East, Europe, and North America.We're not an event logistics tool. We sit at the intersection of event tech, marketing automation, and sales enablement — connecting events to pipeline, revenue, and business outcomes.
About the RoleWe're looking for a Product Manager who comes from a B2B SaaS background and knows what it takes to build a high-performing product from scratch — not just maintain one. Someone who has lived through the messy, zero-to-one phase of building product where there's no playbook, no established process, and you have to figure out what to build, why it matters, and how to ship it — all at the same time. You should be the kind of PM who can look at a complex enterprise workflow, understand why it breaks, sketch a better version, and rally the team to ship it. You should also be someone who communicates exceptionally well — whether that's writing a crisp product spec, leading a cross-functional alignment meeting, presenting a roadmap to the founders, or getting on a call with an enterprise buyer and asking the right questions to uncover what they actually need. At Samaaro, you'll own product across a platform that spans audience intelligence, campaign automation, registration workflows, QR check-in, lead capture, CRM integrations, and analytics dashboards. You'll work directly with the founders, engineering, design, customer success, and sales. You'll talk to enterprise marketing teams regularly. You'll see your decisions go live fast. This role is for someone who is deeply self-motivated — someone who doesn't wait for direction but actively seeks out problems, uses every tool at their disposal (including AI), and moves from insight to mockup to spec without needing someone to hold their hand through each step. If you want to build a category-defining product in a high-trust, high-velocity environment — and you're the kind of person who'd prototype a new feature in Figma or with an AI tool before the standup is over — this is the role.
What You'll Own
Product Discovery & Customer IntelligenceDevelop a deep understanding of Samaaro's ICP: marketing leaders, field marketers, demand gen teams, and event operations managers at mid-market and enterprise companies running 6+ events per year.Speak with customers and prospects regularly to uncover real pain points — not surface-level feature requests, but the workflow friction that slows them down.Conduct structured competitor and market research across event tech, marketing automation, and CRM ecosystems.Translate insights into clear product direction that strengthens product–market fit and expands our category lead.
Thinking, Designing & PrototypingTake ownership of the product thinking process end-to-end: from identifying the problem to sketching solutions to producing functional mockups.Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Figma AI, v0, or similar) to rapidly brainstorm concepts, generate UI mockups, draft copy, and stress-test ideas — before involving the full design and engineering team.Create low-fidelity and mid-fidelity wireframes and flows that communicate intent clearly enough to kick off engineering conversations.Collaborate with design for high-fidelity polish, but be capable of moving from zero to tangible artifact on your own.
Problem Structuring & RequirementsBreak large, ambiguous enterprise problems into structured, actionable work — across modules like registration, campaigns, check-in, lead capture, CRM sync, and reporting.Write clear functional flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge-case documentation.Work with design to ensure every experience is simple, intuitive, and built for enterprise users who don't have time to figure things out.Use data — product analytics, customer feedback patterns, funnel metrics — to justify decisions, not assumptions.
Execution & DeliveryWork closely with engineering to refine tickets, unblock decisions, and maintain shipping momentum.Review builds, test flows end-to-end, and participate actively in QA before releases.Own release notes, internal documentation, and feature communication to GTM teams.Maintain tight alignment with customer success and sales so product decisions reflect what's happening in the field.
Product Performance & Continuous ImprovementTrack product metrics — adoption, engagement, drop-off, NPS — and use them to identify gaps and opportunities.Identify friction points across the platform and propose improvements that move the needle on retention and expansion.Align product decisions with ICP needs, PMF direction, and the company's broader event marketing category vision.
What We're Looking For
Must-haves:2–5 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS — this is non-negotiable. You understand SaaS business models, enterprise buyer journeys, multi-stakeholder deals, and the rhythm of building product that serves paying business customers.Demonstrated experience building product from scratch or near-scratch — you've been in environments where you had to define the problem, shape the solution, set up processes, and ship without relying on an established playbook. You know what zero-to-one feels like.Exceptional communication skills — both written and verbal. You can write a spec that engineers don't need to ask questions about, run a meeting that ends with decisions not confusion, present confidently to founders and leadership, and hold your own in conversations with enterprise customers. Communication is not a checkbox for this role — it's a core skill that shows up in everything you do.Strong analytical mindset — you're comfortable with data, metrics, and making decisions backed by evidence.Ability to read API documentation, understand system architecture basics, and have informed conversations with engineers.Proven ability to go from problem to prototype independently — using design tools, AI tools, or even pen-and-paper sketches to communicate ideas quickly.Comfort with AI-assisted workflows — you already use AI tools for brainstorming, drafting, research, or design, and you're constantly experimenting with new ones.High ownership mindset — you don't wait to be told what to do; you find the problem, propose the solution, and drive it forward.Comfort with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and the pace of an early-stage company scaling fast.Ability to talk to enterprise customers and stakeholders with confidence and curiosity.
Strong signals:Experience in enterprise SaaS, event tech, CRM platforms, or marketing automation — bonus if you've worked on workflow-heavy products where the user journey is non-linear.You've built and shipped a product (or a major module) from zero — defined the v1 scope, shaped the architecture conversations, and iterated based on early customer feedback.Hands-on experience with Figma, Whimsical, or similar design/prototyping tools.Familiarity with AI-powered design and prototyping tools (v0, Galileo AI, Relume, or similar).Exposure to SQL, analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase), or product instrumentation.Experience writing release documentation, participating in QA, or running beta programs.You've worked in a startup where you had to build process alongside product — and you thrived in it.
Why SamaaroBuild the category, not just the product. Samaaro sits in a whitespace between event management and marketing automation — you'll help define what event marketing platforms become.Ship fast, learn fast. Small team, short cycles, direct founder access. Your decisions go live in days, not quarters.AI-native product culture. We use AI across our product and our process. You'll be expected to push boundaries on how AI can accelerate product thinking and delivery.Real ownership. You won't be a ticket writer. You'll own outcomes — from discovery to adoption.Global, enterprise impact. Your work will be used by marketing teams at companies like PepsiCo, ICICI Lombard, and Property Finder across multiple continents.Growth path. Clear trajectory to Senior PM or Product Lead as the team scales.Competitive compensation with performance-linked growth.

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Project Manager specializing in finishes to oversee and coordinate all finishing trades across construction projects. This role requires 6-8 years of hands-on experience managing blockwork, finishing, gypsum installation, painting, and post-pour works. The ideal candidate will ensure quality execution, maintain project schedules, and coordinate multiple subcontractors to deliver exceptional finishing standards.

Key Responsibilities

The Assistant Project Manager - Finishes will manage the complete lifecycle of finishing works from planning through final handover. This includes coordinating with architects, engineers, and subcontractors to ensure specifications are met while maintaining budget and schedule adherence. You'll review shop drawings and material submittals for blockwork, gypsum systems, and finishing materials, ensuring compliance with design intent and building codes.

Daily responsibilities include supervising subcontractor performance across multiple work fronts, conducting quality inspections at critical stages, and implementing corrective actions when standards aren't met. You'll prepare and maintain detailed progress reports, identify potential delays or conflicts early, and develop mitigation strategies to keep projects on track.

Managing the RFI process for finishing trades falls under your purview, as does maintaining accurate as-built documentation. You'll conduct regular site walks to verify workmanship quality, coordinate material deliveries to prevent schedule disruptions, and ensure proper sequencing of trades to maximize efficiency.

Post-pour works coordination requires particular attention to waterproofing details, expansion joint installation, and surface preparation standards. You'll verify that concrete surfaces meet flatness and finish requirements before subsequent trades proceed, preventing costly rework.

Required Qualifications

Experience: 6-8 years of progressive experience managing finishes on commercial, residential, or mixed-use construction projects. Demonstrated expertise in blockwork installation including structural and non-structural applications, partition systems, and CMU construction. Proven track record with gypsum board systems, metal framing, acoustic ceilings, and specialty finishing applications.

Technical Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of painting systems including surface preparation, priming, and finish coat applications across various substrates. Detailed knowledge of post-pour remediation techniques, concrete surface treatments, and waterproofing applications. Familiarity with building codes, ASTM standards, and industry best practices for finishing trades.

Skills: Strong ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, finishing schedules, and specifications. Proficient in project management software and Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel for schedule tracking and cost monitoring. Excellent coordination abilities to manage multiple subcontractors simultaneously while maintaining quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or related field. Certifications in project management or specific finishing trades. Experience with LEED or sustainable building practices. Background working on projects exceeding $50 million in construction value.

Core Competencies

Leadership and team coordination skills with the ability to motivate subcontractors and resolve conflicts effectively. Strong problem-solving capabilities with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential issues. Excellent communication skills for interfacing with clients, consultants, and project stakeholders. Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities to manage documentation and track multiple work packages simultaneously. Commitment to safety with understanding of site-specific hazards related to finishing trades.
